issues.problem: The printed token is bandhurasi with short -a-. The split bandhurā + asi would give bandhurāsi (cf. the six -āpi forms in lines a and b, all with long ā). The mismatch is not recorded. No variant is claimed; only the discrepancy is noted.

patch.text: The printed bandhurasi has short a; the split bandhurā + asi (f., agreeing with ketaki) would normally be written bandhurāsi. The word is read as bandhurā + asi on sense; the vowel length is left as printed and not corrected.

summary: Unit 4: sumahimā is masculine, renown should be glory, and the ca is moved to clause head. Unit 5: the draft's double negation in na dattam upatiṣṭhate is unsupported; literal reading given, confidence lowered. Unit 6: misplaced and/और between pairs, weak vā flag. Unit 16: Hindi adds तो. Units 11 and 14: gram labels made consistent. Unit 18: added his/own. Unit 21: short-a bandhurasi noted. Units 1, 2, 7-10, 12, 15, 17, 19, 20 ok. No regrouping.
